description: This source file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing connectors, including CRUD operations such as listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting connectors. It imports schema models and service functions, and exposes API endpoints for these operations.

methods.name: list_connectors(tenant_id: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by tenant_id"))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list connectors, supports optional filtering by tenant_id, and returns a paginated list of connector responses.

methods.name: create_connector(payload: ConnectorCreateRequest)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new connector record based on provided schema data.

methods.name: get_connector(connector_id: str)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific connector by ID, raises NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: update_connector(connector_id: str, payload: ConnectorUpdateRequest)
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update label and config of a connector by ID, raises NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: delete_connector(connector_id: str)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a connector by ID, raises NotFoundError if not found.
